dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Bah, Stormterror was defeated, just like that? We didn't even get the chance to take the stage...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Oh, if it isn't the Honorary Knight. The storms have ceased, and Stormterror has been defeated.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: This is a good thing, yes... But couldn't Stormterror have put up a bit more of a fight?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: And here I was thinking that after clearing the monsters surrounding the city out, we could select some elite adventurers to form a team of dragon hunters to challenge Stormterror!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: But just as we were having trouble finding a healer, Stormterror was defeated.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: We also need to help the citizens find cats and dogs, send meals and clean house... At this rate, we'll have lost our opportunity for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* Let's leave that aside for now. I've heard from our scouts that there are still monsters wandering the Whispering Woods.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: But our forces are scattered throughout the wilds and cannot return, and I must handle some assorted matters.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Could I trouble you to go to the Whispering Woods and see to the situation there?
